summary: xAI has open-sourced the source code for Grok Build, its coding agent and terminal UI, including the agent loop, tools, terminal interface, and extension system (skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, subagents), and added the ability to run it fully local-first against a self-hosted inference backend.

mechanisms.reason: The harness can now be pointed at a locally-run inference backend rather than a cloud endpoint, shifting a share of inference off datacenter-served APIs.
mechanisms.quote: Grok Build can now run fully local-first: compile it yourself, point it at your own local inference, and drive everything from your config.toml .

practices.reason: The published source is a concrete, inspectable reference implementation of an agentic coding harness (context assembly, tool-call dispatch, extension loading) that a team could study or fork directly.
practices.quote: The agent loop: how context is assembled, how model responses are parsed, and how tool calls are dispatched

practices.reason: Local-first operation and compile-it-yourself distribution changes how a team could wire the agent to its own model or infra, though no migration or deprecation is required.
practices.quote: Grok Build can now run fully local-first: compile it yourself, point it at your own local inference, and drive everything from your config.toml .
